players.product: Metal soft-magnetic materials and chip inductors (including modular inductors for vertical power delivery) that supply front-end power to GPU, CPU, ASIC and FPGA chips in AI servers

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 1,183,110,305.22, up 37.46% YoY, mainly on higher chip inductor revenue; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 225,638,246.75, up 17.95%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 223,299,314.61, up 18.71%; operating cash flow RMB 140,498,187.38, down 46.49%. Net profit grew slower than revenue mainly because of share-based payment costs from a new, larger equity incentive plan. Q2 revenue rose 41.65% QoQ and Q2 net profit attributable rose 54.90% QoQ. Electronic components gross margin 38.65% (-1.16 points); metal soft-magnetic powder products revenue RMB 1,153,073,536.06 (+38.56%), gross margin 38.38%.

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (H1 2026): AI chip inductor revenue grew substantially and the company's global AI chip inductor market share rose significantly, driven by top cloud vendors' higher capex and in-house ASIC programs lifting demand for modular inductors and optical-module inductors. TLVR inductors now exceed 30% of AI chip inductor sales revenue, and the products have been recognized by several global leading semiconductor companies and cloud service providers. Product series include GP, CFS, BR and HP.
quarterly_data.figure: TLVR inductors over 30% of AI chip inductor revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (half-year report, H1 2026): metal soft-magnetic powder core capacity stayed tight; the company expects industry growth to continue and will keep expanding powder core capacity. Chip inductor capacity is still short of demand; the company will raise capital investment and accelerate capacity expansion for AI data-center demand, and reserve capacity in advance for edge AI (AI PCs, AI phones, smart driving, humanoid robots). Inventory rose to RMB 394,393,654.98 (end-2025 RMB 280,747,363.18) as raw materials and finished goods were stocked to secure order delivery.
quarterly_data.figure: chip inductor capacity short of demand; powder core capacity tight

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Metal soft-magnetic powder (half-year report, H1 2026): revenue was roughly flat YoY because fast growth of the AI chip inductor business sharply raised internal demand for the powder, slowing external market expansion; the company will step up capacity and investment in amorphous / nanocrystalline powders and other high-performance soft-magnetic materials to meet internal and external demand.

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report outlook (H1 2026): the company expects its metal soft-magnetic powder core business to maintain steady growth and its AI chip inductor business to keep developing at high speed.

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (half-year report, H1 2026): R&D investment RMB 102,939,920.51, up 67.06%, 8.7% of revenue, on more R&D staff, new projects and share-based payment costs.

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Raised-fund project (half-year report, H1 2026): the new high-end integrated molded inductor construction project has used all its raised funds (RMB 29,698.66 ten-thousand cumulative by June 30, 2026) and is expected to reach ready-for-use state on August 31, 2027; it realised a benefit of RMB 8,205.77 ten-thousand in H1 2026. Construction in progress RMB 235,925,960.43 at June 30, 2026; fixed assets RMB 1,396,456,970.21; other non-current assets (prepaid equipment and construction) RMB 164,340,677.09 (end-2025 RMB 30,413,150.69).
